name: vamsi-command
description: A private owner operating system for evidence-first priorities, decisions, releases and workspace boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Run founder work through one evidence-first command method.
interface.longDescription: A private founder workflow that separates KRAVIA corporate operations from personal ventures, verifies changing facts from connected sources, keeps a compact decision queue, and refuses to claim releases or high-risk actions without evidence.
defaultPrompt: Run my owner command review and tell me only what needs my attention.
Audit this release and ship it only if every required gate is green.
Turn these updates into one decision with evidence, risks and the next action.
